name: Jaron Bradley
biography: Jaron is the Director of Jamf Threat Labs where he focuses on discovering new ways to keep user's safe on Apple devices. He is author of the books "Threat Hunting macOS" and "OS X Incident Response". In his free time he manages themittenmac.com, a site dedicated to helping others learn security on the Apple ecosystem.
